_meta.openai/toolInvocation/invoking: Writing your changes into the PDF

description:
Change, correct or delete text INSIDE the original PDF, keeping its fonts, sizes, colors and layout.

Use this whenever the user wants their existing PDF updated rather than a
new document: fix a typo, change a date, amount, name or address, update a
CV or a price list, translate a heading, remove a line. Read the PDF first,
then pass one edit per change with `find` copied exactly as printed in the
document. Dates and amounts written differently in the PDF (12/08/2026 vs
August 12, 2026; 1240 vs 1,240.00) are matched and rewritten in the
document's format.

edits.description:
Changes to write, applied in order. Each one replaces every
occurrence of `find` (only on `page` when given).

items.description: One change to write into the PDF.

find.description: Text to replace, copied exactly as it is printed in the PDF (same spelling, accents and punctuation). Keep it short: one line or a few words is most reliable.

page.description: 1-based page number to limit this change to. Omit to change every occurrence in the document.

replace.description: New text written in place of `find`. An empty string deletes the text.

file.description: The PDF to edit (shared in the conversation).

download_url.description: URL from which the file can be downloaded.

mime_type.description: MIME type of the file, e.g. application/pdf.

name: edit_pdf_text
title: Edit text in PDF
